finding: PAR-07/S8 local DataStorage boundary-index correctness refinement
scope: Treat a bounded DataIndex-targeted record header's payload offset as a boundary sentinel even when its declared entrySize is invalid, so an earlier record cannot consume across it.

format_reference.name: ODA Open Design Specification for .dwg files v5.4.1, §24.2.2.2-.3
format_reference.relevant_rule: DataIndex local offsets select data-record headers; each record's maxRecordSize is the difference between consecutive payload-stream offsets. The spec lists Entry size but does not define malformed Entry size behavior.

evidence.pre_change_behavior: The boundary-index prepass skipped any indexed header whose entrySize was less than DATA_RECORD_HEADER_SIZE. A generated predecessor with a payload size extending across that omitted boundary did not receive datastorage-record-payload-out-of-record.
evidence.post_change_behavior: The prepass keeps the bounded header's recordLocalOffset independently of entrySize. The main pass rejects the malformed target with datastorage-record-entry-invalid, and the preceding payload is rejected against that retained boundary.
evidence.fixture_policy: All DataStorage bytes are generated in memory; no persistent DWG/DXF fixture is added.

validation.result: Expected failure on the new malformed-boundary assertion; this demonstrated the behavior gap.

evidence_boundary: This conservative parser invariant does not assert that ODA specifies semantics for malformed entrySize values. Structural replay remains refused for the section. No peer/native consumer, full suite, or external fixture was used.
implementation_status: implemented in the shared uncommitted worktree; not staged or committed because Git metadata is read-only and the worktree contains extensive pre-existing changes
self_unblock: Continue the local PAR-07/S8 DataStorage record-offset/owner audit at the next uncovered source-backed invariant; optional external qualification remains non-blocking.
